key.name: folder
key.summary: Wallpaper folder

key.name: recursive
key.summary: Include subfolders

key.name: interval
key.summary: Seconds between wallpaper changes

key.name: paused
key.summary: Stop changing wallpapers on the timer

key.name: favorite-weight
key.summary: How many times per cycle a favorite is shown

key.name: prescale
key.summary: Shrink large images to screen size before showing them
key.description: Keeps GNOME Shell from holding full-size 4K/8K textures in memory.

key.name: cache-size
key.summary: Disk space for prepared wallpapers, in MB
key.description: Scaled copies and converted JPEG XL, AVIF and HEIC wallpapers are kept in ~/.cache/wallslaed up to this size, so they aren't prepared again every round.

key.name: transition
key.summary: Transition effect between wallpapers

key.name: transition-duration
key.summary: Transition length in milliseconds

key.name: animated-enabled
key.summary: Include animated wallpapers (GIF and video)

key.name: animated-pause-when-covered
key.summary: Pause animated wallpapers while a maximized or fullscreen window covers the desktop

key.name: animated-pause-on-battery
key.summary: Show a still frame instead of animating while on battery

key.name: music-folder
key.summary: Music video folder
key.description: Videos here play with sound when picked, and never come up in the rotation. Empty means Videos/Music.

key.name: music-volume
key.summary: Music video volume

key.name: music-max-height
key.summary: Highest video resolution to download, in pixels of height

key.name: pexels-api-key
key.summary: Pexels API key, for browsing animated wallpapers

key.name: pixabay-api-key
key.summary: Pixabay API key, for browsing animated wallpapers

key.name: blur-strength
key.summary: Blur strength, in pixels

key.name: blur-brightness
key.summary: Brightness of blurred surfaces
key.description: 1 leaves colours alone; lower darkens them so text stays readable.

key.name: blur-overview
key.summary: Blur the wallpaper behind the overview

key.name: blur-panel
key.summary: Show the blurred wallpaper behind the top bar

key.name: blur-dash
key.summary: Make the dash see-through over the blurred overview

key.name: blur-popups
key.summary: Blur behind menus, quick settings, notifications, dialogs and the window switcher

key.name: blur-app-folders
key.summary: Blur behind open app folders

key.name: blur-screenshot
key.summary: Blur behind the screenshot tool's panel

key.name: blur-lockscreen
key.summary: Make the lock screen's blur follow the blur strength and brightness
key.description: GNOME blurs the lock screen either way; off leaves its own look.

key.name: blur-apps
key.summary: Set the blur behind app windows that ask for it
key.description: GNOME 51 blurs behind windows of apps that request it (GTK 4.24 apps using backdrop-filter, some terminals). Off leaves GNOME's own setting.

key.name: blur-apps-strength
key.summary: Blur radius behind app windows, in pixels

key.name: topbar-autohide
key.summary: Hide the top bar while a window of the focused app overlaps it
key.description: The bar still shows in the overview and while one of its menus is open, and maximized windows use the whole screen.

key.name: topbar-reveal-at-edge
key.summary: Show the hidden top bar when the pointer pushes against the top edge
